description: Read-only public tool references, device setup and own-VPS server assistant engineering books for the user's AI; this service cannot operate devices.

setupBook.title: Device setup, phone sharing and router workflow engineering book

service_interface.scope: Isolated Linux loopback MCP SDK, HTTP, book resources, prompt, schema and static reference consistency. This is interface verification, not physical router installation or public production verification.

scope: Isolated Linux IPv4 loopback SOCKS application through Shadowsocks 2022 TCP to a TLS fixture, sing-box 1.14.4.
Wrong-port failure and a single-factor repair; disconnect failure and successful reconnection.
Observed route and server-side test DNS; process cleanup and unchanged host network.

mobile_hotspot.scope: Physical Android/iOS phone selection, Wi-Fi coexistence, hotspot/tethering, downstream DNS/IPv6/UDP, screen-off, thermal and reconnection acceptance. Executable procedures are specified; no hardware result is claimed.

router_hardware.scope: Main book navigation to the merlin workflow; no physical router, install, downstream traffic or recovery execution.

capability_boundaries: This knowledge MCP is read-only; the user's authorized AI operates the actual target device.
The book grants no extra authorization. Respect the active task and required system permissions.
Credentials, subscription URLs, private device details and logs stay local to the target device.
Retrieval is not evidence that a device was configured. Validation metadata states its exact tested scope.
A phone VPN does not by itself prove tethered clients use that VPN; verify downstream traffic separately.
Router package matching is source-backed selection, not tested hardware compatibility; verify actual firmware, ABI and LAN behavior.

serverAssistant.title: 华润服务器助手安装与使用

service_interface.scope: Linux real ASGI JSON-RPC and HTTP transport parity, no-argument privacy guards, pinned resource/prompt/tool content, explicit server intent routing and existing phone/router regressions. Not public production deployment or a new installer run.

installer_acceptance.scope: One isolated Debian 12 x86_64 installation, real Linux Xray client and PicoClaw/DeepSeek fault repair. Physical phones, ARM and other distributions were not tested.

capability_boundaries: This knowledge MCP is read-only; the user's authorized AI operates the actual target device.
The book grants no extra authorization. Respect the active task and required system permissions.
Credentials, subscription URLs, private device details and logs stay local to the target device.
Retrieval is not evidence that a device was configured. Validation metadata states its exact tested scope.
Installation and huarun chat run on the user-owned authorized VPS over SSH; the public MCP never receives its credentials.
Server health checks are not proof of actual phone or desktop client connectivity; verify the real client separately.
